previous_statement: By def-maincb-reset-state and def-extended-delta-inclusion, record the output of node 1.2.1 with source B_R=B_U oplus B_V, target A_R, ambient field epsilon_R, fixed amplification family, map-defect d_R, and its preserved extended-isomorphism tag. Since R=U union V, A_R=A_{U union V}; since the Stage-3 envelope selected epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon and certified A_R as extended epsilon_R-C*, this field satisfies epsilon_R<=W.L*epsilon (indeed equality). Renaming v_R,d_R,epsilon_R as v_{U union V},d_{U union V},epsilon_{U union V} gives every assertion in node 1 and hence proves node 1.2.
new_statement: The output exported by node 1.2.1 cannot, from the allowed inputs, be recorded as a current reset isomorphism. By def-extended-delta-inclusion, an extended d_R-isomorphism requires both that v_R be an extended d_R-inclusion (hence that every fixed amplification be a d_R-homomorphism with the two-sided (1+-d_R) norm bounds) and that v_R be bijective. Node 1.2.1 exports bijectivity, the numerical inequality d_R<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_R, a near-unit estimate, and unchanged amplification form, but it does not export that v_R is an extended d_R-inclusion. By def-maincb-reset-state, the map-defect number and the extended-isomorphism tag are separate fields, so the former cannot supply the latter. Consequently node 1.2, and hence node 1, do not follow from the registered external contracts; completion requires strengthening and re-importing lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation so that its contract explicitly states that the error-improved v_R is an extended d_R-inclusion (then its already-exported preservation of bijectivity would make v_R an extended d_R-isomorphism).
